purpose: Inspectable decision tree. Walk `walk` in order. Each node has exactly one adopted option (what ships) and one target. Kind is derived in tree.ts: lock (adopted===target), fork (lock with two written sources), claimed (adopted!==target and claimedIssue), gap (named in proposedIssues). An agent does not pick a fourth option.

nodes.question: What is the phone for?
nodes.attention: If the phone hosts the model, identity becomes a model picker and the laptop is optional. That is ChatGPT. Dash's human is directing a laptop fleet with one thumb.

options.label: Hosted consumer chat
options.because: Resells tokens. Fifth working-memory chunk is the model name.

options.label: Desktop fleet board
options.because: 390px cannot hold project + thread + diff.

options.label: Phone control surface over laptop CLIs

nodes.question: What is a conversation's identity?
nodes.attention: A model name is not a place. Harness + host is a place the human can retrieve.

options.label: GPT-4o / Opus dropdown
options.because: Model choice lives in the CLI. Phone identity is who is running.

nodes.question: Where do the three destinations live?
nodes.attention: Bottom third is thumb + IME. Destinations are glanceable (peripheral). Labels in a bottom bar steal the composer.

options.label: iOS-style tab bar
options.because: Composer already owns the bottom. language.md forbids it.

options.label: Grok-style drawer
options.because: storyboard.md: density only, Dash uses top tabs.

nodes.question: How tall is destination chrome?
nodes.attention: Every px of chrome is a tax on the stream. 80px was an accidental mutation class.

options.label: 80px spacer
options.because: Mutation target. NAV_CHROME_HEIGHT is 60.

nodes.question: What is on screen at cold open?
nodes.attention: Retrieve last chat vs encode the self-dev loop. Two written sources disagree. That is the fork. Do not silently pick.

options.label: Whatever tab was last used
options.because: Cold open becomes nondeterministic. The tree would not converge.

options.label: Chats (index 1)
options.because: language.md and MainScreen useState(1). Retrieval of last thread.

options.label: Orchestra (index 2)
options.because: Issue #29 / PR #33. Self-dev loop as the default encode surface.

nodes.fork: Issue #29 wants Orchestra. language.md still says Chats. Until language.md changes, the tree keeps Chats. Do not implement Orchestra default from this catalog.

nodes.question: Where is global search / message?
nodes.attention: Thumb. The dock is the encode surface for the whole app, not a chat-only composer.

options.label: Top search field
options.because: Fights IME and thumb.

nodes.question: When are scope chips visible?
nodes.attention: Prune. Chips are a fourth chunk only while encoding a scope.

options.label: Persistent chip row
options.because: Steals vertical stream space when idle.

nodes.question: How does the composer sit relative to messages?
nodes.attention: A floating composer covers the last token. That is the last thing the human needs to see.

options.label: FAB / overlap
options.because: setproduct: most common mobile AI chat bug.

nodes.question: How does the dock follow the Android IME?
nodes.attention: Covering 'Message Dash' breaks encode. S25 does not resize the window.

options.label: paddingBottom: insets.bottom
options.because: softwareKeyboardLayoutMode resize is ignored in Expo Go.

options.label: RN KeyboardAvoidingView
options.because: dash-android-ui forbids it on the dock.

nodes.question: What does Enter do?
nodes.attention: Phone keyboards insert newline. Desktop Enter sends. Mixing them makes people send half a thought.

options.label: Enter always sends
options.because: Phone users need newline.

nodes.question: What does the composer + control do?
nodes.attention: A visible control that does nothing is a lie. It burns a tap and trains distrust.

options.label: Plus icon, no onPress
options.because: Dead affordance. Inspected in Composer.tsx.

options.label: Attach image/file into the turn
options.because: Needs protocol. Do not fake it with a no-op.

nodes.question: How do send and voice share one slot?
nodes.attention: One trailing control. Empty = speak. Text = send popIn. Two icons at rest is extra chrome.

options.label: Mic and send always visible
options.because: Crowds the 48px dock.

options.label: Mic when empty, send popIn when text

nodes.question: What happens to the composer while a turn streams?
nodes.attention: Stop must be reachable without losing the next encoded thought. Queue is a second slot, not a new thread.

options.label: Disable input until done
options.because: Human encodes faster than some harnesses.

nodes.question: How is assistant text chromed?
nodes.attention: A second bubble around the stream doubles containers. Grok already solved this.

options.label: Both sides bubbled
options.because: language.md: assistant is plain.

nodes.question: How is user text chromed?
nodes.attention: User vs assistant must be parseable in a glance. One bubble side is enough.

options.label: Both plain
options.because: Turns collapse into one column of prose.

nodes.question: How is tool work shown during a turn?
nodes.attention: Tool JSON is exposure. One line is encoding. numberOfLines={1} is the pin.

options.label: Expandable tool cards
options.because: Steals fovea from the stream on 390px.

options.label: status event, cleared on tool end

nodes.question: What marks that a model is thinking?
nodes.attention: Motion must stay 8px. A caret or row bounce is a second stream.

options.label: Blinking block caret
options.because: Competes with tokens.

options.label: 8px PulseDot
options.because: Shipped on main. dash-motion still names it.

options.label: AODL effort orbs + runtime cadence
options.because: Issue #27 / PR #31. visual.json fail-closed.

nodes.question: Where do tokens live in client state?
nodes.attention: Per-token chats-store updates re-render the list. That hitch is an attention failure.

options.label: Put tokens in conversations[]
options.because: AGENTS.md forbids it.

nodes.question: Do list rows play enter animations?
nodes.attention: FlashList recycle remounts. Entering on rows is a hitch during rest/scroll.

options.label: entering= on rows
options.because: dash-motion. Recycle replays the anim.

nodes.question: What is press feedback?
nodes.attention: Opacity-only press feels cheap. Squash without haptic feels dead. Two languages in one app is noise. Header is unused but still teaches opacity. Pair, Settings, and OrchestraDetail still use pressed && styles.pressed.

options.label: pressed && opacity/background
options.because: dash-motion: kill opacity pressed styles.

options.label: PressScale on rows, opacity on Header IconButton
options.because: Header.tsx still uses pressed && styles.pressed.

options.label: PressScale SNAP transform on every pressable

nodes.question: Where do haptics fire?
nodes.attention: Haptic is the alert tag for plasticity. It belongs on the action, not inside every squash (rows would buzz on scroll-adjacent presses).

options.label: PressScale always haptics
options.because: Rows would vibrate on every press including disabled.

nodes.question: How does the selected destination move?
nodes.attention: The pill is peripheral. It may gel. It must not glow. Glow is a second highlight competing with the stream.

options.label: GOLD_GLOW overlay
options.because: dash-motion forbids it on native AppNav.

options.label: Instant snap, no follow
options.because: Pager drag would leave the indicator behind.

options.label: UI-thread spring follow, stretch X squash Y

nodes.question: How does the human inspect the bridge without leaving Main?
nodes.attention: Pushing Settings is a context switch. A Modal is a new window. A gel sheet stays in the same place.

options.label: Navigate to Settings
options.because: Chevron is glance, not a form.

options.label: RN Modal
options.because: bridge-pull.test.ts: overlay is a gel sheet.

nodes.question: Is voice a mode or a second product?
nodes.attention: Full-duplex camera (Gemini Live) is a different job. Dash voice is one spoken turn over the same harness.

options.label: Mic fills the composer
options.because: Spoken turns need VAD + barge-in. Composer mic is the door, not the room.

nodes.question: Can the human interrupt TTS?
nodes.attention: If they cannot interrupt, they wait. That is not conversation. ChatGPT AVM is the ceiling. Dash already stops the speaker on barge-in.

options.label: Wait for TTS
options.because: Blocks encode.

nodes.question: Does idle motion honor Reduce Motion?
nodes.attention: Springs already pass ReduceMotion.System. PulseDot and the Voice orb loop withTiming forever. That is a vestibular tax.

options.label: withTiming loops regardless
options.because: OS setting is the human's rest gate.

nodes.question: How compressed is a chat row?
nodes.attention: The list is retrieval, not reading. Date group + 1 line + timeAgo + optional live dot.

options.label: Multi-line snippet
options.because: Turns the list into a transcript.

nodes.question: How compressed is a bot row?
nodes.attention: Presence is a dot. Role + 1-line desc. Online pills are a second label.

options.label: Online / Away chips
options.because: language.md: status dot, never Online pills.

nodes.question: Where do turn failures appear?
nodes.attention: A toast is peripheral and dies. The error belongs in the turn the human is reading.

options.label: Banner / toast
options.because: Leaves the thread looking fine.

nodes.question: How is bridge liveness shown when healthy?
nodes.attention: A persistent Connected pill is unused chrome. Prune it.

options.label: Always-on status chip
options.because: Axiom prune.

nodes.question: How does first-run pairing earn trust without a typed token?
nodes.attention: Typing a token is exposure. Hearing a 6-char code is encoding a short ritual. Manual fields remain as fallback.

options.label: Paste address + token
options.because: First-run should not start in Settings.

nodes.question: How do Settings fields avoid the IME?
nodes.attention: Settings fields live in a scroll, not a dock. KeyboardAvoidingView (Keyboard Controller) is the allowed exception.

options.label: KeyboardDock around settings
options.because: There is no bottom composer on this screen.

nodes.question: How do swipe panes and lists coexist?
nodes.attention: One axis per gesture. Horizontal = destinations. Vertical = content. Mixing both on one view is a stolen swipe.

options.label: Horizontal lists inside pager
options.because: Gesture fight.

nodes.question: How does the human watch two harnesses at once?
nodes.attention: One fovea. A second stream must compress to a peripheral mark on the list, not a split view.

options.label: Two threads on one phone screen
options.because: Desktop board. 390px.

options.label: Streaming dot on the Chats row, one open thread
options.because: Shipped. No glanceable fleet of live turns on Main.

options.label: AODL runtimeState marks on Bots/Orchestra while one thread is open
options.because: Encode which agents are running without opening them. visual.json runtimeStates.

nodes.question: What does Orchestra list?
nodes.attention: Demo tiles are exposure. The AODL network is the encoded mesh.

options.label: DEMO_ORCHESTRAS
options.because: Issue #19.

nodes.question: Is a live CLI tab a Chat?
nodes.attention: Minting an empty thread next to a live OMP session is a second agent. The GUI attaches.

options.label: Phone-started threads only
options.because: Issue #20.

nodes.question: What does the left nav circle mean?
nodes.attention: A label that lies spends a tap and trains distrust. Voice is a real destination. Expand is not.

options.label: Label Expand, navigate Voice
options.because: Name ≠ destination. Inspected in AppNav.tsx.

options.label: Expand chrome to labeled tabs
options.because: Would fight 60px collapsed bar.

nodes.question: Where does compose live on Main?
nodes.attention: language.md still says pencil in the header. The phone ships a bottom Message Dash dock. Two written sources. The dock already won the thumb.

options.label: Compose in header pencil
options.because: No pencil control exists in AppNav.

options.label: FAB over the stream
options.because: Covers the last token.

nodes.fork: language.md still says compose lives in the header (pencil). MainScreen GlobalSearchBar is the product. Until language.md changes, the tree keeps the dock.

nodes.question: Which destination dot is selected on Chat and Voice?
nodes.attention: Opening a thread from Orchestra still lights Chats. Peripheral destination is now a lie.

options.label: AppNav tab={1} on Chat and Voice
options.because: ChatScreen and VoiceScreen hardcode tab 1.

options.label: Remember origin tab, or hide the pager on Chat/Voice

nodes.question: Is Conversations first-class or leftover?
nodes.attention: A stack route with zero navigators is chrome the human cannot retrieve. It still long-press deletes.

options.label: Registered modal, no navigate callers
options.because: App.tsx registers Conversations. grep finds no navigate.

options.label: Delete the screen, or wire from Chats overflow

nodes.question: Do Header and TopTabs still ship as a second chrome language?
nodes.attention: Unused components still teach opacity press and labeled tabs. Recycle them into a screen and the dialect comes back.

options.label: Header.tsx and TopTabs.tsx unused
options.because: Zero screen imports of Header. AppNav replaced TopTabs.

options.label: Delete, or re-home only behind PressScale

nodes.question: How does a search row say a bot is live?
nodes.attention: Bots pane uses a dot. Search writes Online/Offline. That is a second vocabulary for the same bit.

options.label: Meta string Online / Offline
options.because: SearchResultRow. language.md forbids Online pills.

nodes.question: What does leading + mean across docks?
nodes.attention: Same glyph, two verbs. Main inserts @. Chat claims Attach and does nothing. That is a collision plus a lie.

options.label: Mention on Main, dead Attach on Chat
options.because: GlobalSearchBar vs Composer.

options.label: Main keeps Mention. Chat hides + until attach is real

nodes.question: How does the phone show a harness waiting on permission?
nodes.attention: AODL has runtimeState blocked. Adapters currently bypass approvals. A frozen status line looks like a hang.

options.label: Keep the 1-line status, no distinct blocked chrome
options.because: Human cannot tell hang from ask.

options.label: AODL blocked encoding in the turn, composer stays
Full permission TUI on the phone
options.because: Laptop owns approvals. Phone surfaces the state.

nodes.question: Do destination tabs use the same squash as nav circles?
nodes.attention: Circles are PressScale. Tabs are raw Pressable. A third dialect on the most-tapped chrome.

options.label: Pressable tabs, PressScale circles
options.because: AppNav.tsx tabs map.

options.label: PressScale on tabs, scale the circle not the pill

nodes.question: What haptic weight is a committed send?
nodes.attention: tap is for chrome. success is for a completed encode. Queue is a lighter event. Offline is error. One weight for all three blurs the loop.

options.label: No haptic on send
options.because: dash-motion: scale without haptic feels cheap.

options.label: haptic.tap on send, queue, and voice utterance
options.because: ChatScreen onSend and sendTurn.

options.label: success on first send, tap on queue, error if offline

nodes.question: Does Voice have an explicit end or mute?
nodes.attention: Hands-free VAD is the job. Zero labeled controls means the only escape is AppNav, which still says Expand and lights Chats.

options.label: Orb + caption, leave via AppNav, barge-in via speech
options.because: VoiceScreen has no End button. Pressable import is unused.

options.label: End/leave control + live labels; optional tap barge-in
Gemini Live camera/screen share
options.because: Different job.

nodes.question: How are chats removed?
nodes.attention: Long-press without a hint is an expert gesture. Swipe-to-delete fights the vertical list. Either needs a discoverable encode.

options.label: 350ms long-press, confirm, no hint, no swipe
options.because: ChatsPane has no accessibilityHint.

options.label: Keep long-press with hint, or an overflow on the row
Swipe-to-delete
options.because: Competes with vertical scroll. Only if long-press is removed.

nodes.question: How does the human refresh hosts when the pill is hidden?
nodes.attention: Healthy bridge is silence. Stale roster with no PTR looks healthy. The pill retry only appears when already broken.

options.label: No pull-to-refresh. Pill retry only when offline
options.because: BotsPane has no RefreshControl.

options.label: PTR on Bots plus existing pill retry

nodes.question: How does the human switch harness mid-thread?
nodes.attention: HarnessPicker is mounted. The only open path is debugUi.chatHarnessPickerOpen. Identity is therefore unretrievable.

options.label: Picker exists, debug-only visible
options.because: ChatScreen never calls setPickerVisible(true) from UI.

options.label: Title tap or BridgePull harness chips open the picker

nodes.question: What happens when an Orchestra agent has no linked chat?
nodes.attention: Haptic plus no navigation is a lie. Disabled + hint, or mint/adopt a chat, are the honest options.

options.label: haptic.select then return
options.because: OrchestraDetailScreen openAgent.

options.label: Disabled with hint, or open/mint the harness chat

nodes.question: How are streaming and connection changes announced?
nodes.attention: Motion-only cues fail VoiceOver/TalkBack. Streaming dots and PulseDot are visual. ConnectionPill has no accessibilityLabel.

options.label: Visible dots/text, no live region, pill unlabeled
options.because: MessageRow and ConnectionPill.

options.label: accessibilityLiveRegion on status; label the pill

nodes.question: Can a vertical list scroll steal the bridge pull?
nodes.attention: One vertical axis. Pull is owned by nav chrome (failOffsetX, activeOffsetY). Pulling from the top of Bots/Chats is the residual fight.

options.label: PTR or pan from list top opens the sheet
options.because: Would fight FlashList and any future PTR.

options.label: Pull stays on nav chrome + chevron

proposedIssues.title: Composer: hide the + until attach is a real turn payload
proposedIssues.why: Visible plus with no onPress is a dead affordance. Target is hide, not a fake picker.

proposedIssues.title: Leading + is Mention on Main and dead Attach on Chat. One glyph, one verb.
proposedIssues.why: Same icon, two verbs, one of them a lie.

proposedIssues.title: One press language: PressScale on Header, Pair, Settings, OrchestraDetail, Conversations
proposedIssues.why: dash-motion says every pressable is PressScale. Opacity pressed styles remain on forms.

proposedIssues.title: AppNav tabs must use PressScale, not raw Pressable
proposedIssues.why: Circles squash. Tabs do not. Third dialect on the destination chrome.

proposedIssues.title: PulseDot and Voice orb must honor ReduceMotion.System
proposedIssues.why: Idle loops withTiming forever. Springs already honor the OS. These two do not.

proposedIssues.title: Bots/Orchestra: AODL runtimeState marks for agents streaming while another thread is open
proposedIssues.why: One fovea. A second live harness is currently only a 6px dot on a Chats row the human may not be looking at.

proposedIssues.title: Surface harness blocked / permission-needed as AODL blocked, not a frozen status line
proposedIssues.why: T3 has full-access vs supervised. Dash adapters bypass. When a turn is blocked the phone has no distinct chrome.

proposedIssues.title: Left nav circle: label Voice, not Expand
Chat and Voice must not hardcode AppNav tab={1}
proposedIssues.why: Opening a thread from Orchestra still lights Chats.

proposedIssues.title: Remove Conversations screen or give it a navigator
Delete unused Header.tsx and TopTabs.tsx, or re-home behind PressScale
proposedIssues.why: Unused chrome still teaches opacity press and labeled tabs.

proposedIssues.title: Search bot rows: status dot, never Online/Offline text
proposedIssues.why: Bots pane already compressed this. Search undoes it.

proposedIssues.title: Send uses success; queue uses tap; offline uses error
proposedIssues.why: ChatScreen fires tap for send and queue. Encode vs chrome should not share a weight.

proposedIssues.title: Voice: labeled End/leave and live region; optional tap barge-in
proposedIssues.why: Hands-free is correct. Zero labeled controls is not. Escape today is a mislabeled Expand.

proposedIssues.title: Chats long-press delete needs an accessibilityHint (or overflow)
proposedIssues.why: 350ms with no hint is undiscoverable. Do not add swipe until long-press is gone.

proposedIssues.title: Bots pane: pull-to-refresh roster, keep pill retry when broken
proposedIssues.why: Healthy-looking stale hosts have no encode path.

proposedIssues.title: Chat: open HarnessPicker from title tap or BridgePull chips
proposedIssues.why: Identity is debug-only. Switching harness mid-thread is a real job.

proposedIssues.title: OrchestraDetail agent row: disable + hint, or mint/adopt a chat
proposedIssues.why: haptic.select then no-op when no linked chat.

proposedIssues.title: Announce streaming status and ConnectionPill; label the pill
proposedIssues.why: Motion-only cues fail TalkBack. Pill has no accessibilityLabel.
